# Steven Kleynenberg — Master Knowledge Index
> Canonical Root: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/
> Location: Delft, South Holland, The Netherlands
> Role: Founder & Principal AI Architect at Kleynenberg Software Ontwikkeling (KSO); Publisher at Kleynenberg Publishers (KP); Host of The Kleynenberg Perspective (TKP)

## Core Identity
Steven Kleynenberg (S.E. Kleynenberg) is a Dutch AI & Systems Architect, inventor, publisher, and broadcaster with over 30 years of R&D experience in Artificial Intelligence, massively parallel neurocomputing (MetaNet / BSP400 / Connection Machine), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and distributed enterprise and clinical systems. Co-inventor of PCT patent application WO 2014/003543 A1 (https://patents.google.com/patent/WO2014003543A1/en) and contributor to European ITEA and EU research consortia (EDAFMIS, MEDUSA, Medolution, PARTNER, LORE).
